quotes.text: And we have this AI boom and major meta center in Richland Parish. But the utility use is unbelievable. I mean, it's several times the use of the city of New Orleans. Have we done our due diligence on this? I don't know.

You know, we have to make sure that the impact of these meta centers, I'm talking to other members of Congress who have had meta centers to, you know, to start in their areas and to see what type of impact it's really having on the water supply and the electricity supply. And, you know, we have to do our due diligence. But I certainly don't want to, you know, get in the way of people having economic opportunity.

NATCHITOCHES, LA — Congressman Cleo Fields (LA-06) today announced that Northwestern State University has been awarded $1.8 million in federal funding through the U.S. Department of Commerce's National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) to support the university's Innovation Park Equipment Expansion (IPEX) Project. The funding request was submitted in collaboration with U.S. Senators Bill Cassidy and John Kennedy.
 
The award will allow the university to purchase cutting-edge equipment for Innovation Park, including an AI supercomputer, laser cutters, and advanced 3D printers.
